card.line: Gibeath-elohim, or Gibeah of God, is a city with a Philistine outpost where Saul met a group of prophets and the Spirit of God came upon him.

moments.title: Samuel foretells the prophets
moments.text: Samuel tells Saul he will come to Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost. There he will meet prophets coming down from the high place with harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, prophesying.

moments.title: Saul prophesies with the prophets
moments.text: When Saul and his servant arrive at Gibeah, a group of prophets meets him. The Spirit of God rushes upon Saul, and he prophesies along with them. Those who knew him ask, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
